assignments.value: ={{ ['Nutify','Recover expired AI work leases','Mutate AI work state','Enqueue AI work','Capture ServerFS CI failure','Auto-Backup n8n Workflows to GitHub (Optimized)'].includes($json.workflow_name) ? 1 : 2 }}

value.markdown: ={{ (() => { const e = $('Format Error Alert').item.json; const lines = ['# 🚨 n8n 工作流运行失败', '', `- **工作流**：${e.workflow_name || 'Unknown workflow'}`, `- **出错节点**：\`${e.error_node || 'Unknown'}\``, `- **错误类型**：\`${e.error_name || 'Error'}\``, `- **HTTP**：\`${e.http_code || '-'}\``, `- **模式**：\`${e.execution_mode || '-'}\``, '', '## 错误详情', String(e.error_message || 'No message')]; if (e.execution_url) lines.push('', `🔗 ${e.execution_url}`); lines.push('', `> Execution: \`${e.execution_id || '-'}\``); return lines.join('\n'); })() }}

parameters.jsCode: const e=$('Compute Incident Fingerprint').first().json;const last=$input.first()?.json||{};const matched=typeof last.work_id==='string'&&last.work_id.startsWith(e.incident_work_id);const terminal=matched&&['completed','failed','blocked'].includes(String(last.status||''));const work_id=matched?(terminal?e.incident_work_id+':r'+String(last.id):last.work_id):e.incident_work_id;return [{json:{...e,incident_work_id:work_id,incident_recovery_of:terminal?last.work_id:'',incident_episode_state:terminal?'reopened':matched?'open':'initial'}}];
